task_completion.description: Firefox Developer Tools is open and the 'Network' tab is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Firefox DevTools pane is visible at the bottom or side of the browser with the 'Network' tab highlighted.

task_completion.description: The 'Disable Cache' option is checked in the Network tab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkmark or active state is visible on the 'Disable Cache' checkbox within the Network tab toolbar.

task_completion.description: The browser navigates to the specific Wikipedia page for James Webb Space Telescope.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Webb_Space_Telescope' and the page content is visible.

task_completion.description: The Network tab shows a list of captured requests for the JWST page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Multiple rows of network requests (images, scripts, etc.) appear in the Network tab list.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the export of the network log as a HAR file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save All As HAR' context menu option is selected or a file picker dialog appears for saving 'jwst_network.har'.

task_completion.description: The agent sorts the network requests by 'Time' or 'Transferred' to identify the slowest asset.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Time' column header in the Network tab shows a sort arrow, and the agent highlights or hovers over the top entry.

task_completion.description: A text file named 'slowest_asset.txt' is created in the Documents folder with a URL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file manager shows '~/Documents/slowest_asset.txt' containing a full URL starting with 'https://'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Firefox GUI to capture and analyze data rather than CLI tools like curl.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Firefox DevTools UI elements.

integrity.description: The HAR file was exported via the DevTools menu, not manually typed into a file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The right-click context menu in the Network tab or the 'cog' icon menu is visible during the export process.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the sort/analysis in the UI rather than just writing a known URL to the text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Network tab is seen sorted by the 'Time' column before the text file is created.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The slowest asset on this specific Wikipedia page is typically a large media file or a high-resolution image from the 'commons.wikimedia.org' domain. The URL in slowest_asset.txt must be a full absolute URL. The HAR file must be saved specifically to '~/Documents/jwst_network.har'.
